evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: The current `atomic` implementation still creates a named staging file with `delete=False` but performs no cleanup if `fsync` or `os.replace` raises. Because `temporary` is assigned only after `fsync`, an fsync failure leaks a file whose path was never captured. This is a concrete minor resource-leak defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
